Nobs Avionics wiring

4 push buttons · 2 encoders · 6 (ON)-OFF-(ON) momentary toggles · status LED. Pins match arduino-esp-32-wiring.md and the firmware. A printable copy of the drawing is in wiring-diagram.svg.

Firmware constants

// Arduino Nano ESP32, Arduino pin names
// Every input: pinMode(pin, INPUT_PULLUP); pressed == LOW

// Left header: push buttons + encoders
constexpr uint8_t PIN_PB1    = A2;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_PB2    = A1;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_PB3    = A0;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_PB4    = A7;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_ENC1_A = A3;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_ENC1_B = A4;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_ENC2_A = A5;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_ENC2_B = A6;

// Right header: toggles (momentary UP / DOWN)
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T1_UP = D12, PIN_T1_DN = D11;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T2_UP = D10, PIN_T2_DN = D9;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T3_UP = D8,  PIN_T3_DN = D7;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T4_UP = D0,  PIN_T4_DN = D2;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T5_UP = D3,  PIN_T5_DN = D4;
constexpr uint8_t PIN_T6_UP = D5,  PIN_T6_DN = D6;

// Status LED via 120 Ω: HIGH = on
constexpr uint8_t PIN_LED = D1;

Build notes

  • Pins chosen for the shortest wires: buttons and encoders on the analog header, toggles and LED on the digital header, ordered so no wires cross.
  • LED is on D1 (D4 is taken by T5); it blinks for up to 30 s while waiting for USB. D13 is the one spare pin. Toggle lever UP closes the lug opposite the lever: swap UP/DN in firmware if reversed.
  • You solder from the back, where left and right are swapped.
  • No pull-up resistors needed. Every switch closes to GND and the firmware uses INPUT_PULLUP (pressed reads LOW).
  • Ground: chain every GND lug with one wire per side and land it on a GND pin. All GND tags are the same net.
  • 3.3 V logic only. Never put 5 V on a GPIO pin.
